results.title: The Wizard of the Kremlin
results.overview: In the chaos of post-Soviet Russia, rising KGB officer Vladimir Putin joins forces with master manipulator Vadim Baranov to reshape life behind the Iron Curtain, using violence and deception to change the world forever.

results.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
results.original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
results.overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

results.title: Best of the Best
results.overview: Two childhood besties join UCLA's competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, only to find the road to the US championships is fiercer than they imagined.

results.title: Animales
results.overview: Four couples sail the thin line between desire and search for authenticity, in a world where truth is as fragile as their relationships.

results.title: Heartstopper Forever
results.overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

results.title: Camp Rock 3
results.overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

results.title: DC
results.overview: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

results.title: Udta Teer
results.overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

results.title: Stop! That! Train!
results.overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

results.title: Kamen Rider ZEZTZ: Farewell Mission
results.original_title: 仮面ライダーゼッツ さよならのミッション
results.overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. Convinced of his innocence, Kensei Odaka/Kamen Rider NOX pursues the true culprit, and finally tracks down the mastermind behind it all, National Public Safety Commission Chairman, Shuma Kumon/Kamen Rider Mugen.

results.title: Signal One
results.overview: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

results.title: Alpha
results.overview: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

results.title: Finding Emily
results.overview: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

results.title: Sugar Mommy
results.overview: When a non-committal sugar mommy takes in her three sugar babies, jealousy erupts as one of them becomes determined to be her one and only.

results.title: The Mosquito Bowl
results.overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

results.title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
results.overview: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

results.title: Take Care of Yourself
results.overview: Alaa, a radio host who fears commitment, enters relationships that end for trivial reasons until he meets Farida, who seems perfect. He then discovers she is one of the largest arms dealers. When he tries to leave her, she forces him to marry her, dragging him into a series of dangerous situations.

results.title: Flavia
results.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

results.title: Quantum Supremacy
results.overview: In a future threatened by rogue robots and an all-powerful AI, Captain Monroe and his crew race to prevent humanity's downfall in Quantum Supremacy.

results.title: Colors of Evil: Black
results.overview: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.
